title.zh: 卷一百一十八 載記第十八 姚興下
title.en: Volume 118 Records 18: Yao Xing Part Two
title.raw: 卷一百一十八 載記第十八 姚興下 Volume 118 Records 18: Yao Xing Part Two

sentences.zh: 卷一百一十八 載記第十八

translations.literal: Volume 118 of the Records, eighteenth installment.
translations.idiomatic: Book of Jin, scroll 118—Annals eighteenth.

sentences.zh: 姚興

translations.literal: Yao Xing.
translations.idiomatic: This installment continues the biography of Yao Xing.

translations.literal: (Continued below.)
translations.idiomatic: (Part two.)

sentences.zh: 晉義熙二年，平北將軍、梁州督護苻宣入漢中，興梁州別駕呂營、漢中徐逸、席難起兵應宣，求救于楊盛。

translations.literal: In Jin's second year of Yixi, General Who Pacifies the North and Liangzhou Defender Fu Xuan entered Hanzhong; Xing's Liangzhou aide Lu Ying, Hanzhong's Xu Yi, and Xi Nan raised troops to answer Xuan and begged Yang Sheng for aid.
translations.idiomatic: Yixi second year: Fu Xuan marched into Hanzhong; Yao Xing's aides Lu Ying and Xu Yi plus Xi Nan rose in support and pleaded with Yang Sheng.

sentences.zh: 盛遣軍臨濜口，南梁州刺史王敏退守武興。

translations.literal: Sheng dispatched troops to Lintang ford; south Liangzhou Inspector Wang Min withdrew to defend Wuxing.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Sheng lunged at Lintang ford while Wang Min fell back on Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 楊盛復通于晉。

translations.literal: Yang Sheng again opened relations with Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Sheng renewed ties with the Jin court.

sentences.zh: 興以太子泓錄尚書事。

translations.literal: Xing charged crown prince Hong with supervising the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing handed crown prince Yao Hong the Secretariat portfolio.

sentences.zh: 慕容超司徒、北地王鐘，右僕射、濟陽王嶷，高都公始，皆來奔。

translations.literal: Murong Chao's minister of education and Prince of Beidi, Zhong; right servant Wang Yi of Jiyang; Duke of Gaodu Shi—all fled hither.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Yan defectors arrived—Zhong the prince of Beidi, Wang Yi of Jiyang, and Shi duke of Gaodu.

sentences.zh: 華山郡地湧沸，廣袤百餘步，燒生物皆熟，曆五月乃止。

translations.literal: In Huashan commandery the earth boiled up across more than a hundred paces; living things burned until cooked; after five months it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Huashan soil erupted across a hundred paces, flash-scorching life until the tide ebbed five months later.

sentences.zh: 赫連勃勃殺高平公沒奕於，收其眾以叛。

translations.literal: Helian Bobo slew Duke of Gaoping Moyifu and seized his host to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Helian Bobo killed Moyifu of Gaoping and drafted his tribes into revolt.

sentences.zh: 先是，魏主拓跋珪送馬千匹，求婚於興，興許之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Wei lord Tuoba Gui had sent a thousand horses seeking marriage with Xing; Xing consented.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoba Gui once offered a thousand mounts for a royal marriage and Xing agreed.

sentences.zh: 以魏別立後，遂絕婚，故有柴壁之戰。

translations.literal: Because Wei set up another empress he broke the match—hence the battle of Chaibi.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei elevated another queen the match collapsed—leading to Chaibi.

sentences.zh: 至是，復與魏通和，魏放狄伯支、姚伯禽、唐小方、姚良國、康宦還長安，皆復其爵位。

translations.literal: Now again they communicated peace with Wei; Wei released Di Bozhi, Yao Boqin, Tang Xiaofang, Yao Liangguo, and Kang Huan back to Chang'an—all ranks were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Peace returned Wei captives—Di Bozhi, Yao Boqin, Tang Xiaofang, Yao Liangguo, Kang Huan—and revived their titles.

sentences.zh: 時禿髮傉檀、沮渠蒙遜迭相攻擊，傉檀遂東招河州刺史西羌彭奚念，奚念阻河以叛。

translations.literal: At the time Tufa Nutan and Juqu Mengxun struck each other in turns; Nutan thereupon eastward summoned Peng Xinian, inspector of Hezhou among the western Qiang; Xinian blocked the river and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Tufa Nutan and Juqu Mengxun traded blows until Nutan beckoned Peng Xinian east across the river—who then barred the ford.

sentences.zh: 蜀譙縱遣使稱籓，請桓謙，欲令順流東伐劉裕。

translations.literal: Shu's Qiao Zong sent envoys declaring vassalage, begging Huan Qian so he might drift downstream eastward to attack Liu Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Zong of Shu offered submission and asked for Huan Qian to float east against Liu Yu.

sentences.zh: 興以問謙，謙請行，遂許之。

translations.literal: Xing consulted Qian; Qian requested to go; Xing granted it.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing asked Huan Qian's wishes and approved his expedition.

sentences.zh: 使中軍姚弼、後軍斂成、鎮遠乞伏乾歸等率步騎三萬伐傉檀，左僕射齊難等率騎二萬討勃勃。

translations.literal: He ordered Central Army Yao Bi, Rear Army Liancheng, Distant Guard Qifu Gangui and others to lead thirty thousand foot and horse against Nutan; Left Servant Qi Nan and others to lead twenty thousand horse against Bobo.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Yao Bi, Liancheng, and Qifu Gangui with thirty thousand west against Nutan; Qi Nan led twenty thousand horse against Helian Bobo.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書尹昭諫曰：「傉檀恃遠，輕敢違逆，宜詔蒙遜及李玄盛，使自相攻擊。

translations.literal: Personnel Minister Yin Zhao remonstrated: "Nutan trusts distance and dares slight disobedience—you ought edict Mengxun and Li Xuansheng to make them strike each other.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Zhao urged letting Mengxun and Li Xuansheng tear Nutan apart.

sentences.zh: 待其斃也，然後取之，此卞莊之舉也。

translations.literal: Wait until they are exhausted, then take them—this is Bian Zhuang's stroke.
translations.idiomatic: " Wait until they weary—then seize both like Bian Zhuang's tigers."

sentences.zh: 」興不從。

translations.literal: " Xing did not follow.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing refused.

sentences.zh: 勃勃退保河曲。

translations.literal: Bobo withdrew to defend the river bend.
translations.idiomatic: Helian Bobo hugged the northern bends.

sentences.zh: 弼濟自金城，弼部將姜紀言於弼曰：「今王師聲討勃勃，傉檀猶豫，未為嚴防，請給輕騎五千，掩其城門，則山澤之人皆為吾有，孤城獨立，坐可克也。

translations.literal: Bi crossed from Jincheng; Bi's officer Jiang Ji told Bi: "Now the royal host loudly campaigns against Bobo; Nutan hesitates without stern defense—grant five thousand light horse to raid his gates and men of hill and marsh become ours; isolated citadel stands alone—sitting we take it.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Ji urged five thousand riders to surprise Nutan while he dithered.

sentences.zh: 」弼不從，進拔昌松，長驅至姑臧。

translations.literal: " Bi did not follow; advanced and took Changsong, drove straight to Guzang.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Bi refused, seized Changsong, and raced to Guzang.

sentences.zh: 傉檀嬰城固守，出其兵擊弼，弼敗，退據西苑。

translations.literal: Nutan ringed the city in stubborn defense, sent troops out to strike Bi; Bi was defeated and withdrew to hold the western park.
translations.idiomatic: Nutan sallied from Guzang, broke Yao Bi, who fled to the western compounds.

sentences.zh: 興又遣衛大將軍姚顯率騎二萬，為諸軍節度。

translations.literal: Xing again sent Guard Grand General Yao Xian with twenty thousand horse as coordinator of hosts.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing reinforced with Yao Xian and twenty thousand riders as theater commander.

sentences.zh: 至高平，聞弼敗績，兼道赴之，撫慰河外，率眾而還。

translations.literal: Reaching Gaoping he heard Bi's defeat, doubled march thither, soothed lands beyond the river, and led the host back.
translations.idiomatic: At Gaoping news of Bi's rout sent him sprinting to steady the frontier before pulling back.

sentences.zh: 傉檀遣使人徐宿詣興謝罪。

translations.literal: Nutan sent envoy Xu Su to Xing to apologize.
translations.idiomatic: Nutan apologized through Xu Su.

sentences.zh: 齊難為勃勃所擒。

translations.literal: Qi Nan was captured by Bobo.
translations.idiomatic: Helian Bobo bagged Qi Nan.

sentences.zh: 興遣平北姚沖、征虜狄伯支、輔國斂曼嵬、鎮東楊佛嵩率騎四萬討勃勃。

translations.literal: Xing dispatched General Who Pacifies the North Yao Chong, General Who Conquers Captives Di Bozhi, Assistant to the State Liancheng Manwei, General Who Guards the East Yang Fosong with forty thousand horse against Bobo.
translations.idiomatic: He hurled Yao Chong, Di Bozhi, Liancheng Manwei, and Yang Fosong—forty thousand riders—at Bobo.

sentences.zh: 沖次於嶺北，欲回師襲長安，伯支不從，乃止，懼其謀泄，遂鴆殺伯支。

translations.literal: Chong halted north of the ranges, wished to wheel and raid Chang'an; Bozhi refused; he stopped; fearing the plot would leak he poisoned Bozhi.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Chong plotted a coup at Chang'an; Di Bozhi balked, so Chong poisoned him to silence the secret.

sentences.zh: 時王師伐譙縱，大敗之，縱遣使乞師於興。

translations.literal: At the time the royal army campaigned against Qiao Zong and utterly defeated him; Zong sent envoys begging troops from Xing.
translations.idiomatic: While Jin crushed Qiao Zong, the Shu prince begged Yao Xing for rescuers.

sentences.zh: 興遣平西姚賞、南梁州刺史王敏率眾二萬救之，王師引還。

translations.literal: Xing sent General Who Pacifies the West Yao Shang and south Liangzhou Inspector Wang Min with twenty thousand to save him; the royal army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Shang and Wang Min marched twenty thousand east; Jin retired.

sentences.zh: 縱遣使拜師，仍貢其方物。

translations.literal: Zong sent envoys acknowledging tutelage and again presented local tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Zong renewed fealty and sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 興遣其兼司徒韋華持節策拜縱為大都督、相國、蜀王，加九錫，備物典策一如魏、晉故事，承制封拜悉如王者之儀。

translations.literal: Xing sent concurrent minister of education Wei Hua with credentials to appoint Zong grand commander-in-chief, chief minister, king of Shu, conferring the nine bestowals; ritual gear matched Wei-Jin precedent; acting authority to enfeoff mirrored kings.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Hua draped Qiao Zong in nine tinsel honors and kingly seals aping Wei-Jin ritual.

sentences.zh: 興自平涼如朝那，聞沖謀逆，以其弟中最少，雄武絕人，猶欲隱忍容之。

translations.literal: Xing went from Pingliang toward Chaona; hearing Chong plotted rebellion—among brothers the youngest, martial prowess surpassing others—still wished to endure and tolerate him.
translations.idiomatic: Riding from Pingliang toward Chaona, Yao Xing learned Yao Chong plotted treason yet hesitated to strike his fierce youngest brother.

sentences.zh: 斂成泣謂興曰：「沖凶險不仁，每侍左右，臣常寢不安席，願早為之所。

translations.literal: Liancheng wept and told Xing: "Chong is fierce and perilous without kindness; whenever he attends your side your servant cannot sleep sound—I pray you deal with him early.
translations.idiomatic: Liancheng begged through tears—Chong's cruelty kept every minister sleepless.

sentences.zh: 」興曰：「沖何能為也！

translations.literal: " Xing said: "What can Chong do!
translations.idiomatic: " Yao Xing scoffed, "What harm can he do?

sentences.zh: 但輕害名將，吾欲明其罪于四海。

translations.literal: Yet lightly harming a famed general—I wish to clarify his crime within the Four Seas.
translations.idiomatic: " I mean to expose his guilt to the realm before acting."

sentences.zh: 」乃下書賜沖死，葬以庶人之禮。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he issued an edict granting Chong death and buried him with commoner rites.
translations.idiomatic: An edict forced Chong to die and buried him as a commoner.

sentences.zh: 晉河間王子國璠、章武王子叔道來奔，興謂之曰：「劉裕匡復晉室，卿等何故來也」國璠等曰：「裕與不逞之徒削弱王室，宗門能自修立者莫不害之。

translations.literal: Jin's prince of Hejian Guofan and prince of Zhangwu Shudao fled hither; Xing told them: "Liu Yu restores Jin—why do you come?
translations.idiomatic: Jin princes Guofan and Shudao defected; Yao Xing asked why they fled Liu Yu's restoration.

sentences.zh: 是避之來，實非誠款，所以避死耳。

translations.literal: Guofan and others said: "Yu together with unrestrained men weakens the royal house—whatever clan branch can stand on its own he harms.
translations.idiomatic: They answered that Liu Yu butchered every royal house still upright.

sentences.zh: 」興嘉之，以國璠為建義將軍、揚州刺史，叔道為平南將軍、兗州刺史，賜以甲第。

translations.literal: Therefore fleeing here is no sincere devotion—we flee death.
translations.idiomatic: " They admitted they ran only to survive."

sentences.zh: 興如貳城，將討赫連勃勃，遣安遠姚詳及斂曼嵬、鎮軍彭白狼分督租運。

translations.literal: " Xing praised them, appointed Guofan General Who Establishes Righteousness and Yangzhou inspector, Shudao General Who Pacifies the South and Yanzhou inspector, gifting mansions.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing rewarded them with provincial commands and estates.

sentences.zh: 諸軍未集而勃勃騎大至，興欲留步軍，輕如嵬營。

translations.literal: Xing went to Ercheng intending to campaign against Helian Bobo; he sent Secure-the-Distance Yao Xiang and Liancheng Manwei with Guard-Army Peng Bailang to oversee grain convoys.
translations.idiomatic: At Ercheng he prepared war on Bobo, detailing Yao Xiang, Manwei, and Peng Bailang on logistics.

sentences.zh: 眾咸惶懼，群臣固以為不可，興弗納。

translations.literal: Hosts had not gathered when Bobo's riders arrived in force; Xing wished to leave foot troops and lightly ride to Manwei's camp.
translations.idiomatic: Before concentrations finished Bobo struck; Yao Xing meant to abandon infantry for a dash to Manwei.

sentences.zh: 尚書郎韋宗希旨勸興行。

translations.literal: All were terrified; ministers firmly deemed it impossible; Xing would not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Courtiers forbade the gamble; he brushed them off.

sentences.zh: 蘭台侍御史姜楞越次而進曰：「韋宗傾險不忠，沮敗國計，宜先腰斬以謝天下。

translations.literal: Secretariat Gentleman Wei Zong encouraged Xing according to hidden wishes.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zong curried favor urging the ride.

sentences.zh: 脫車駕動軫，六軍駭懼，人無守志，取危之道也，宜遣單使以征詳等。

translations.literal: Assistant palace censor Jiang Leng stepped past rank and advanced: "Wei Zong leans treacherous and disloyal, wrecks state plans—you ought first cut him at the waist to apologize to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Leng demanded Wei Zong's bisection for sabotaging policy.

sentences.zh: 」興默然。

translations.literal: Should Your carriage tremble forth the six armies panic without steadfast hearts—the way to invite peril—better dispatch lone envoys to summon Xiang and others.
translations.idiomatic: " Stay off the road—send riders for Xiang instead."

sentences.zh: 右僕射韋華等諫曰：「若車騎輕動，必不戰自潰，嵬營亦未必可至，惟陛下圖之。

translations.literal: " Xing fell silent.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing stayed mute.

sentences.zh: 」興乃遣左將軍姚文宗率禁兵距戰，中壘齊莫統氐兵以繼之。

translations.literal: Right servant Wei Hua and others remonstrated: "If chariot and horse move lightly they collapse without battle; Manwei's camp may not be reachable—only Your Majesty ponder.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Hua warned the dash would melt the army before contact.

sentences.zh: 文宗與莫皆勇果兼人，以死力戰，勃勃乃退。

translations.literal: " Xing then sent General of the Left Yao Wenzong leading forbidden troops to resist battle; Central Rampart Qi Mo commanded Di troops to follow.
translations.idiomatic: He relented, fed Yao Wenzong palace guards and Qi Mo's Di auxiliaries into the line.

sentences.zh: 留禁兵五千配姚詳守貳城，興還長安。

translations.literal: Wenzong and Mo were both fiercer than common men; fighting with death resolve Bobo withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Wenzong and Qi Mo threw suicidal valor until Bobo peeled away.

sentences.zh: 譙縱遣其侍中譙良、太常楊軌朝於興，請大舉以寇江東。

translations.literal: He left five thousand forbidden troops assigned to Yao Xiang guarding Ercheng; Xing returned to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Five thousand guards stayed with Yao Xiang at Ercheng while Yao Xing rode home.

sentences.zh: 遣其荊州刺史桓謙、梁州刺史譙道福率眾二萬東寇江陵。

translations.literal: Qiao Zong sent attendant-in-ordinary Qiao Liang and grand master Yang Gui to court Xing, begging a major thrust to raid Jiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Zong's envoys begged a joint strike on the lower Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 興乃遣前將軍苟林率騎會之。

translations.literal: He dispatched Jingzhou inspector Huan Qian and Liangzhou inspector Qiao Daofu with twenty thousand east to raid Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: He lent Huan Qian and Qiao Daofu twenty thousand easterners.

sentences.zh: 謙屯枝江，林屯江津。

translations.literal: Qian camped at Zhijiang; Lin camped at Jiangjin.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Qian anchored Zhijiang; Gou Lin hugged Jiangjin.

sentences.zh: 謙，江左貴族，部曲遍于荊、楚，晉之將士皆有叛心。

translations.literal: Qian was gentry of the eastern Yangzi—retinues filled Jing and Chu—Jin officers nursed betrayal.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Qian's noble name seduced wavering Jin troops.

sentences.zh: 荊州刺史劉道規大懼，嬰城固守。

translations.literal: Jingzhou Inspector Liu Daogui was greatly afraid and ringed the city in stubborn defense.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Daogui sealed Jiangling in panic.

sentences.zh: 雍州刺史魯宗之率襄陽之眾救之，道規乃留宗之守江陵，率軍逆戰。

translations.literal: Yongzhou Inspector Lu Zongzhi led Xiangyang troops to rescue him; Daogui therefore left Zongzhi guarding Jiangling and led troops to meet battle.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zongzhi raced from Xiangyang; Daogui left him holding Jiangling and sortied.

sentences.zh: 謙等舟師大盛，兼列步騎以待之。

translations.literal: Qian's navy flourished greatly and also drew foot and horse to await them.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Qian massed river hulls backed by land arms.

sentences.zh: 大戰枝江，謙敗績，乘輕舸奔就苟林，晉人獲而斬之。

translations.literal: Great battle at Zhijiang—Qian suffered defeat; riding light skiffs he fled to Gou Lin; Jin caught and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhijiang shattered Huan Qian; fleeing to Gou Lin earned him Jin's axe.

sentences.zh: 苟林懼而引歸。

translations.literal: Gou Lin feared and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Gou Lin fled upstream.

sentences.zh: 興以國用不足，增關津之稅，鹽竹山木皆有賦焉。

translations.literal: Xing because state stores were insufficient increased passes and ford taxes—salt, bamboo, mountain timber all bore levy.
translations.idiomatic: Empty coffers drove tolls on salt, bamboo, and timber.

sentences.zh: 群臣咸諫，以為天殖品物以養群生，王者子育萬邦，不宜節約以奪其利。

translations.literal: All ministers remonstrated that Heaven breeds goods to nurture creatures—the king fathers myriad lands—ought not pinch thrift to seize profit.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers protested Heaven's bounty should not be taxed into misery.

sentences.zh: 興曰：「能逾關梁通利於山水者，皆豪富之家。

translations.literal: Xing said: "Those able to cross passes and bridges profiting from hills and streams are all wealthy houses.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing answered that only magnates rode those profits.

sentences.zh: 吾損有餘以裨不足，有何不可！

translations.literal: I harm surplus to aid deficiency—what is not permitted!
translations.idiomatic: " I skim the rich to feed the poor—why not?"

sentences.zh: 」乃遂行之。

translations.literal: " Thereupon it proceeded.
translations.idiomatic: The levies stuck.

sentences.zh: 興從朝門游于文武苑，及昏而還，將自平朔門入。

translations.literal: Xing roamed from Chaomen to the civil-military park; reaching dusk he returned intending to enter through Pingzhuo Gate.
translations.idiomatic: He toured the imperial park until dusk and aimed for Pingzhuo Gate.

sentences.zh: 前驅既至，城門校尉王滿聰被甲持杖，閉門距之，曰：「今已昏暗，奸良不辨，有死而已，門不可開。

translations.literal: When van arrived city gate captain Wang Mancong donned armor grasping staff, shut the gate refusing him, saying: "Now it is already dark—good and wicked cannot be distinguished—death alone awaits—gates cannot open.
translations.idiomatic: Captain Wang Mancong barred the dusk entrance—darkness hides assassins.

sentences.zh: 」興乃回從朝門而入。

translations.literal: " Xing therefore returned through Chaomen.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing doubled back through Chaomen.

sentences.zh: 旦而召滿聰，進位二等。

translations.literal: At dawn he summoned Mancong and raised him two grades.
translations.idiomatic: Dawn brought Mancong two promotions.

sentences.zh: 乞伏乾歸以眾叛，攻陷金城，執太守任蘭。

translations.literal: Qifu Gangui rebelled with host, captured Jincheng, seized prefect Ren Lan.
translations.idiomatic: Qifu Gangui stormed Jincheng and took Ren Lan.

sentences.zh: 蘭厲色責乾歸以背恩違義，乾歸怒而囚之，蘭遂不食而死。

translations.literal: Lan sternly reproached Gangui for betraying grace and violating righteousness; Gangui angrily imprisoned him; Lan then fasted to death.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Lan scolded Gangui's treason and starved in chains.

sentences.zh: 赫連勃勃遣其將胡金纂將萬餘騎攻平涼。

translations.literal: Helian Bobo sent officer Hu Jinzuan with more than ten thousand riders to assault Pingliang.
translations.idiomatic: Bobo hurled Hu Jinzuan at Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 興如貳城，因救平涼，纂眾大潰，生擒纂。

translations.literal: Xing went to Ercheng and thereby relieved Pingliang; Jinzuan's host utterly collapsed; Jinzuan was taken alive.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing relieved from Ercheng, captured Hu Jinzuan, and scattered his riders.

sentences.zh: 勃勃遣兄子提攻陷定陽，執北中郎將姚廣都。

translations.literal: Bobo sent elder brother's son Ti to capture Dingyang and seize North Gentlemen-General Yao Guangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Bobo's nephew Ti took Dingyang and bagged Yao Guangdu.

sentences.zh: 興將曹熾、曹雲、王肆佛等各將數千戶避勃勃內徙，興處佛於湟山澤，熾、雲于陳倉。

translations.literal: Xing's officers Cao Chi, Cao Yun, Wang Sifo each led several thousand households fleeing Bobo inward; Xing settled Fo among Zhuang marshes, Chi and Yun at Chencang.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Chi, Cao Yun, and Wang Sifo shepherded refugees inland—Fo to Zhuang wetlands, the Caos to Chencang.

sentences.zh: 勃勃寇隴右，攻白崖堡，破之，遂趣清水。

translations.literal: Bobo raided Longyou, assaulted Baiya fort, broke it, then hurried to Qingshui.
translations.idiomatic: Bobo ripped Longyou, cracked Baiya fort, and raced toward Qingshui.

sentences.zh: 略陽太守姚壽都委守奔秦州，勃勃又收其眾而歸。

translations.literal: Lüeyang Prefect Yao Shoudu abandoned defense and fled to Qinzhou; Bobo again gathered his host and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Shoudu bolted to Qinzhou; Bobo scooped up his men.

sentences.zh: 興自安定追之，至壽渠川，不及而還。

translations.literal: Xing pursued from Anding to Shouqu Stream, did not catch him and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing chased from Anding to Shouqu Stream but missed him.

sentences.zh: 初，天水人姜紀，呂氏之叛臣，阿謅奸詐，好問人之親戚。

translations.literal: Earlier Tianshui man Jiang Ji, rebel minister of the Lu clan, fawned with treacherous deceit and delighted in probing others' kin.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Ji of Tianshui—a Lu turncoat—survived on flattery and gossip.

sentences.zh: 興子弼有寵于興，紀遂傾心附之。

translations.literal: Xing's son Bi enjoyed favor with Xing; Ji therefore poured heart into attaching to him.
translations.idiomatic: He latched onto favored prince Yao Bi.

sentences.zh: 弼時為雍州刺史，鎮安定，與密謀還朝，令傾心事常山公顯，樹黨左右。

translations.literal: Bi at the time was Yongzhou inspector guarding Anding; secretly plotting return to court he ordered wholehearted service to Duke of Changshan Xian, planting partisans left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Bi, anchoring Anding, plotted a Chang'an comeback through Duke Xian's faction.

sentences.zh: 至是，興以弼為尚書令、侍中、大將軍。

translations.literal: At this Xing appointed Bi minister of education, palace attendant, grand general.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing promoted Bi to minister of education, attendant-in-ordinary, and grand general.

sentences.zh: 既居將相，虛襟引納，收結朝士，勢傾東宮，遂有奪嫡之謀矣。

translations.literal: Once occupying general and minister he opened bosom drawing partisans, gathering court scholars—power tilted east palace—and thereupon harbored designs to seize heirship.
translations.idiomatic: Bi captured civil-military posts, stacked allies, and angled for the heir's stool.

sentences.zh: 興以勃勃、乾歸作亂西北，傉檀、蒙遜擅兵河右，疇咨將帥之臣，欲鎮撫二方。

translations.literal: Xing because Bobo and Gangui made turmoil northwest and Nutan and Mengxun monopolized troops west of the river consulted on commander-ministers wishing to pacify both quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest rebels and Hexi warlords drove Yao Xing to hunt governors.

sentences.zh: 隴東太守郭播言於興曰：「嶺北二州鎮戶皆數萬，若得文武之才以綏撫之，足以靖塞奸略。

translations.literal: Longdong Prefect Guo Bo spoke to Xing: "North-of-range two provinces' garrison households each number tens of thousands—could civil-martial talent soothe them it suffices to quiet frontiers against villain plots.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Bo urged posting talent on the northern marches.

sentences.zh: 」興曰；

translations.literal: Xing said;
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing replied,

sentences.zh: 「吾每思得廉頗、李牧鎮撫四方，使便宜行事。

translations.literal: " I always ponder gaining Lian Po and Li Mu to pacify four quarters letting them act expediently.
translations.idiomatic: " I dream of border wardens with Lian Po's grit—free to improvise."

sentences.zh: 然任非其人，恆致負敗。

translations.literal: Yet appointments miss the right men—always incurring defeat.
translations.idiomatic: " Wrong picks keep breaking armies."

sentences.zh: 卿試舉之。

translations.literal: You try nominating them.
translations.idiomatic: " Name names."

sentences.zh: 」播曰：「清潔善撫邊，則平陸子王元始；

translations.literal: " Bo said: "Pure and skilled soothing borders—then Baron of Pinglu Wang Yuanshi;
translations.idiomatic: Guo Bo offered Wang Yuanshi for clean frontier rule;

sentences.zh: 雄武多奇略，則建威王煥；

translations.literal: heroic martial with many stratagems—then Establishes Might Wang Huan;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Huan for battlefield cunning;

sentences.zh: 賞罰必行，臨敵不顧，則奮武彭蠔。

translations.literal: rewards and punishments certain, facing foe without flinching—then Rouses Might Peng Hao.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Hao for iron discipline."

sentences.zh: 」興曰：「蠔令行禁止則有之，非綏邊之才也。

translations.literal: " Xing said: "Peng Hao commands prohibition yes—but not talent to soothe borders.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing granted Peng Hao discipline but denied him soft power.

sentences.zh: 始、煥年少，吾未知其為人。

translations.literal: Yuanshi and Huan are young—I do not yet know their persons.
translations.idiomatic: " The Wang youths remain unknown quantities."

sentences.zh: 」播曰：「廣平公弼才兼文武，宜鎮督一方，願陛下遠鑒前車，近悟後轍。

translations.literal: " Bo said: "Duke of Guangping Bi joins civil and martial—fitting to supervise one quarter—I pray Your Majesty mirror the overturned cart ahead and heed tracks behind.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Bo pushed Duke Yao Bi—begging Yao Xing to learn from past wrecks.

sentences.zh: 」興不從，以其太常索棱為太尉，領隴西內史，綏誘乾歸。

translations.literal: " Xing did not follow; appointed grand master of ceremonies Suo Leng grand commandant concurrent interior secretary of Longxi to coax Gangui.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing spurned Bi and sent Suo Leng to coax Gangui.

sentences.zh: 政績既美，乾歸感而歸之。

translations.literal: Government performance already excellent Gangui was moved and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Good governance lured Gangui back.

sentences.zh: 太史令任猗言於興曰：「白氣出於北方，東西竟天五百里，當有破軍流血。

translations.literal: Court Astrologist Ren Yi spoke to Xing: "White vapors issue from the north stretching east-west five hundred li across Heaven—there will be shattered armies and flowing blood."
translations.idiomatic: Ren Yi warned of a northern white band spanning the sky—omens of slaughter.

sentences.zh: 」乞伏乾歸遣使送所掠守宰，謝罪請降。

translations.literal: " Qifu Gangui sent envoys returning seized prefects, apologizing and begging surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Gangui returned captives and sued for peace.

sentences.zh: 興以勃勃之難，權宜許之，假幹歸及其子熾磐官爵。

translations.literal: Xing because of Bobo's crisis expediently granted it, provisionally conferring offices and noble ranks on Gangui and his son Chipan.
translations.idiomatic: Helian Bobo forced Yao Xing to paper over Gangui's revolt with titles for father and son.

sentences.zh: 姚詳時鎮杏城，為赫連勃勃所逼，糧盡委守，南奔大蘇。

translations.literal: Yao Xiang then guarded Xingcheng; pressed by Helian Bobo, grain exhausted he abandoned defense and fled south to Dasu.
translations.idiomatic: Starving at Xingcheng under Bobo, Yao Xiang bolted south.

sentences.zh: 勃勃耍之，眾散，為勃勃所執。

translations.literal: Bobo ambushed him; his host scattered; Xiang was seized by Bobo.
translations.idiomatic: Bobo snapped the column and took Xiang.

sentences.zh: 時遣衛大將軍顯迎詳，詳敗，遂屯杏城，因令顯都督安定嶺北二鎮事。

translations.literal: At the time Guard Grand General Xian was sent to welcome Xiang; Xiang defeated, he therefore camped at Xingcheng and ordered Xian to supervise both Anding and north-of-range garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xian rallied at Xingcheng after Xiang's loss and took theater command.

sentences.zh: 潁川太守姚平都自許昌來朝，言於興曰：「劉裕敢懷奸計，屯聚芍陂，有擾邊之志，宜遣燒之，以散其眾謀。

translations.literal: Yingchuan Prefect Yao Pingdu came from Xuchang to court and told Xing: "Liu Yu dares cherish treacherous designs, massing at Quebei with intention to disturb the borders—you ought dispatch forces to burn him and scatter his plotting host."
translations.idiomatic: Yao Pingdu spotted Liu Yu massing at Quebei and urged a preemptive strike.

sentences.zh: 」興曰：「裕之輕弱，安敢窺吾疆埸！

translations.literal: " Xing said: "Yu's lightness and weakness—how dare he spy on my frontier!
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing sneered at Liu Yu's nerve.

sentences.zh: 苟有奸心，其在子孫乎！

translations.literal: If treacherous heart exists—would it not lie with descendants!
translations.idiomatic: Let any plot pass to his sons!"

sentences.zh: 」召其尚書楊佛嵩謂之曰：「吳兒不自知，乃有非分之意。

translations.literal: " He summoned Minister Yang Fosong telling him: "Wu men do not know themselves—yet harbor ambition beyond their station.
translations.idiomatic: He told Yang Fosong the easterners craved too much.

sentences.zh: 待至孟冬，當遣卿率精騎三萬焚其積聚。

translations.literal: Waiting until early winter I shall dispatch you leading thirty thousand picked riders to burn their stores.
translations.idiomatic: Come first frost he would send thirty thousand riders to torch Jin granaries.

sentences.zh: 」嵩曰：「陛下若任臣以此役者，當從肥口濟淮，直趣壽春，舉大眾以屯城，縱輕騎以掠野，使淮南蕭條，兵粟俱了，足令吳兒俯仰回惶，神爽飛越。

translations.literal: " Song said: "Should Your Majesty entrust your servant this mission—cross the Huai at Feikou, strike straight for Shouchun, raise great host to camp the city, loose light riders to scour the fields—make Huainan desolate so soldiers and grain alike end—sufficient to make Wu men reel north-south in panic, spirits scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fosong mapped a deep raid—Feikou crossing, Shouchun thrust, wasting Huai lands.

sentences.zh: 」興大悅。

translations.literal: " Xing greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing delighted in the plan.

sentences.zh: 時西胡梁國兒于平涼作壽塚，每將妻妾入塚飲宴，酒酣，升靈床而歌。

translations.literal: At the time western Hu Liang Guoer at Pingliang built a longevity tomb; often bringing wives and concubines into the tomb to drink feast—wine flushed he mounted the spirit couch singing.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Guoer banqueted inside his living tomb west of Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 時人或譏之，國兒不以為意。

translations.literal: People of the time sometimes mocked him; Guoer paid no mind.
translations.idiomatic: Gossip rolled off him.

sentences.zh: 前後征伐，屢有大功，興以為鎮北將軍，封平輿男，年八十餘乃死。

translations.literal: Front and rear on campaign repeatedly earning great merit Xing appointed him General Who Guards the North and enfeoffed Baron of Pingyu; aged over eighty he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died past eighty a decorated frontier general.

sentences.zh: 時客星入東井，所在地震，前後一百五十六。

translations.literal: At the time a guest star entered Eastern Well; everywhere earthquakes—one hundred fifty-six front and rear.
translations.idiomatic: Guest stars and one hundred fifty-six tremors rocked the realm.

sentences.zh: 興公卿抗表請罪，興曰：「災譴之來，咎在元首；

translations.literal: Xing's dukes and ministers submitted memorials begging blame; Xing said: "Disaster and reproach arriving fault lies with the sovereign;
translations.idiomatic: Court offered ritual blame; Yao Xing owned the fault.

sentences.zh: 近代或歸罪三公，甚無謂也。

translations.literal: Recent ages sometimes blamed the Three Dukes—quite meaningless.
translations.idiomatic: Blaming the Three Excellencies misses the mark.

sentences.zh: 公等其悉冠履復位。」

translations.literal: You gentlemen all resume caps and shoes to posts."
translations.idiomatic: He bade ministers retake their seats unscathed.

sentences.zh: 仇池公楊盛叛，侵擾祁山。

translations.literal: Duke of Chouchi Yang Sheng rebelled raiding Qishan.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Sheng of Chouchi struck toward Qishan.

sentences.zh: 遣建威趙琨率騎五千為前鋒，立節楊伯壽統步卒繼之，前將軍姚恢、左將軍姚文宗入自鷲陝，鎮西、秦州刺史姚嵩入羊頭陝，右衛胡翼度從陰密出自汧城，討盛。

translations.literal: He dispatched Establishes Might Zhao Kun with five thousand riders as vanguard, Standing Integrity Yang Boshou commanding foot to follow, Forward General Yao Hui and Left General Yao Wenzong entering through Jiashan, Guard West Qinzhou Inspector Yao Song entering Yangtou Pass, Right Guard Hu Yidu emerging from Yinmi toward Qian city to punish Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Columns rolled from four passes against Yang Sheng.

sentences.zh: 興將輕騎五千，自雍赴之，與諸將軍會于隴口。

translations.literal: Xing would lead five thousand light riders from Yong to rush thither, joining generals at Longkou.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing himself rode five thousand to Longkou.

sentences.zh: 天水太守王松忿言於嵩曰：「先皇神略無方，威武冠世，冠軍徐洛生猛毅兼人，佐命英輔，再入仇池，無功而還。

translations.literal: Tianshui Prefect Wang Songfen told Song: "Late emperor's divine stratagem knew no bound martial awe crowned the age Champion Xu Luosheng fierce resolve doubling men supporting mandate splendid aide twice entered Chouchi yet returned without merit.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Songfen reminded Yao Song that even Xu Luosheng twice failed Chouchi.

sentences.zh: 非楊盛智勇能全，直是地勢然也。

translations.literal: It is not that Yang Sheng's wit and courage suffice—purely terrain acts thus.
translations.idiomatic: Terrain alone saves Yang Sheng—not genius.

sentences.zh: 今以趙琨之眾，使君之威，准之先朝，實未見成功。

translations.literal: Now using Zhao Kun's host and your lordship's awe measuring against prior court truly success not yet seen.
translations.idiomatic: Kun's column hardly bests old expeditions.

sentences.zh: 使君具悉形便，何不表聞？

translations.literal: Your lordship fully knows terrain's convenience—why not memorialize?
translations.idiomatic: Memorialize before marching.

sentences.zh: 」嵩不從。

translations.literal: " Song did not follow.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Song brushed him off.

sentences.zh: 盛率眾與琨相持，伯壽畏懦弗進，琨眾寡不敵，為盛所敗，興斬伯壽而還。

translations.literal: Sheng led host stalemate with Kun; Boshou fearful cowardice did not advance; Kun's host few could not match defeated by Sheng Xing beheaded Boshou and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Boshou hung back; Kun lost; Yao Xing executed Boshou.

sentences.zh: 嵩乃具陳松忿之言，興善之。

translations.literal: Song thereupon fully stated Songfen's words Xing approved.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Song repeated the warning and Yao Xing agreed.

sentences.zh: 乾歸為其下人所殺，子熾磐新立，群下咸勸興取之。

translations.literal: Gangui killed by his subordinates son Chipan newly raised all subordinates urged Xing to take him.
translations.idiomatic: After Gangui's murder ministers urged striking Chipan.

sentences.zh: 興曰：「乾歸先已返善，吾方當懷撫，因喪伐之，非朕本志也。」

translations.literal: Xing said: "Gangui earlier returned to goodness I ought cherish and soothe—riding mourning to attack him is not Our original intent."
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing refused to exploit the funeral.

sentences.zh: 以楊佛嵩都督嶺北討虜諸軍事、安遠將軍、雍州刺史，率領北見兵以討赫連勃勃。

translations.literal: He appointed Yang Fosong supervisor of north-of-range punitive hosts, Secure-the-Distance General Yongzhou Inspector leading northern troops seen to campaign Helian Bobo.
translations.idiomatic: He gave Yang Fosong northern command against Bobo.

sentences.zh: 嵩發數日，興謂群臣曰：「佛嵩驍勇果銳，每臨敵對寇，不可制抑，吾常節之，配兵不過五千。

translations.literal: Several days after Song departed Xing told ministers: "Fosong fierce brave sharp always facing foe cannot rein—I always restrained him assigning troops not exceeding five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Days later Yao Xing fretted Yang Fosong's rash streak.

sentences.zh: 今眾旅既多，遇賊必敗。

translations.literal: Now hosts already multitudinous meeting bandits surely defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Too many riders doom him.

sentences.zh: 今去已遠，追之無及，吾深憂之。

translations.literal: Now gone already far chasing not reaching We deeply worry.
translations.idiomatic: Too late to recall—deep anxiety.

sentences.zh: 」其下咸以為不然。

translations.literal: " Those below all deemed it not so.
translations.idiomatic: Courtiers disagreed.

sentences.zh: 佛嵩果為勃勃所執，絕亢而死。

translations.literal: Fosong indeed seized by Bobo throat cut dying.
translations.idiomatic: Bobo captured Yang Fosong and cut his throat.

sentences.zh: 興立昭儀齊氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Xing established imperial concubine Qi as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Qi became empress.

sentences.zh: 又下書以其故丞相姚緒、太宰姚碩德、太傅姚旻、大司馬姚崇、司徒尹緯等二十四人配饗於萇廟。

translations.literal: Again issuing edict assigning former chief minister Yao Xu grand tutor Yao Shuode grand mentor Yao Min grand marshal Yao Chong minister Yin Wei among twenty-four to paired sacrifice at Chang's temple.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-four late ministers joined sacrifices at Yao Chang's shrine.

sentences.zh: 興以大臣屢喪，令所司更詳臨赴之制。

translations.literal: Xing because ministers repeatedly died ordered offices rehearse protocols for attending deathbeds.
translations.idiomatic: Repeated deaths pushed ritual review.

sentences.zh: 所司白興，依故事東堂發哀。

translations.literal: Offices reported Xing following precedent Eastern Hall mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Rites proposed Eastern Hall wakes.

sentences.zh: 興不從，每大臣死，皆親臨之。

translations.literal: Xing did not follow—every great minister dying he personally attended.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing insisted bedside vigils.

sentences.zh: 姚文宗有寵于姚泓，姚弼深疾之，誣文宗有怨言，以侍御史廉桃生為證。

translations.literal: Yao Wenzong enjoyed Hong's favor Yao Bi deeply hated him accusing Wenzong of resentful words using attendant censor Lian Taosheng witness.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Bi framed Wenzong before crown prince Hong.

sentences.zh: 興怒，賜文宗死。

translations.literal: Xing angry granted Wenzong death.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing ordered Wenzong dead.

sentences.zh: 是後群臣累足，莫敢言弼之短。

translations.literal: Thereafter stacked feet ministers none dared speak Bi's faults.
translations.idiomatic: Silence swallowed Yao Bi's sins.

sentences.zh: 時貳縣羌叛興，興遣後將軍斂成、鎮軍彭白狼、北中郎將姚洛都討之。

translations.literal: At the time Ercounty Qiang rebelled against Xing Xing sent Rear General Liancheng Guard-Army Peng Bailang North Gentlemen-General Yao Luodu to punish.
translations.idiomatic: Qiang mutiny near Er drew punitive columns.

sentences.zh: 斂成為羌所敗，甚懼，詣趙興太守姚穆歸罪。

translations.literal: Liancheng, defeated by the Qiang and terrified, went to Yao Mu, prefect of Zhao Xing, to confess his guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Beaten, Liancheng crawled to Yao Mu.

sentences.zh: 穆欲送殺之，成怒，奔赫連勃勃。

translations.literal: Mu wished send kill him Cheng angry fled Helian Bobo.
translations.idiomatic: Mu meant to execute him; Liancheng bolted to Bobo.

sentences.zh: 興遣姚紹與姚弼率禁衛諸軍鎮撫嶺北。

translations.literal: Xing dispatched Yao Shao with Yao Bi leading forbidden guard hosts pacifying north of ranges.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Shao and Yao Bi steadied the northern marches.

sentences.zh: 遼東侯彌姐亭地率其部人南居陰密，劫掠百姓。

translations.literal: Marquis of Liaodong Mizijie Tingdi led his tribes south dwelling Yinmi plundering commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Mizijie Tingdi raided Yinmi villages.

sentences.zh: 弼收亭地送之，殺其眾七百餘人，徙二千餘戶于鄭城。

translations.literal: Bi seized Tingdi sending him killed his host over seven hundred persons moved over two thousand households to Zheng city.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Bi slaughtered seven hundred and relocated two thousand families.

sentences.zh: 弼寵愛方隆，所欲施行，無不信納。

translations.literal: Bi's dotage swelling whatever wished enacted none not trusted accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Every whim of Yao Bi's won approval.

sentences.zh: 乃以嬖人尹沖為給事黃門侍郎，唐盛為治書侍御史，左右機耍，皆其黨人，漸欲廣樹爪牙，彌縫其闕。

translations.literal: Thereupon treating favorites Yin Chong as Yellow Gate attendant-in-ordinary Tang Sheng as drafting palace censor left-right pivots of power all his clique men gradually wishing broadly plant claws and teeth stitching his gaps.
translations.idiomatic: He stacked the palace with Bi loyalists—Yin Chong and Tang Sheng at the levers.

sentences.zh: 右僕射梁喜、侍中任謙、京兆尹尹昭承間言於興曰：「父子之際，人罕得而言。

translations.literal: Right servant Liang Xi attendant Ren Qian capital intendant Yin Zhao seized interval telling Xing: "Between father and son rarely may men speak.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Xi, Ren Qian, and Yin Zhao broached succession.

sentences.zh: 然君臣亦猶父子，臣等理不容默。

translations.literal: Yet lord and minister likewise resemble father and son—we cannot remain silent.
translations.idiomatic: Silence ill suits ministers.

sentences.zh: 並後匹嫡，未始不傾國亂家。

translations.literal: Twin empresses rivaling heir never yet failed to overturn state and disorder house.
translations.idiomatic: Split succession wrecks dynasties.

sentences.zh: 廣平公弼奸凶無狀，潛有陵奪之志，陛下寵之不道，假其威權，傾險無賴之徙，莫不鱗湊其側。

translations.literal: Duke of Guangping Bi treacherous vicious without measure secretly harbors ambition to overawe seize Your Majesty dotages him beyond measure lending awesome authority—leaning treacherous rogues none fail to scale clustering his side.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Bi gathers villains under royal favor.
